import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source CSV files
source_files = {
    "source0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_0.csv",
    "source1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_1.csv",
    "source2": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_2.csv",
    "source3": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_3.csv",
    "source4": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_4.csv",
    "source5": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_5.csv",
    "source6": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_6.csv",
    "source7": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_7.csv",
    "source8": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_8.csv",
    "source9": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_67/training_9.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source0"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source1"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'INTERACTIONS_NUM']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source2"], index_col=0)  # ['CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED', 'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP']
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source3"], index_col=0)  # same schema as df2
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source4"], index_col=0)  # same schema as df2
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source5"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM']
df6 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source6"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'KEYWORDS_NUM']
df7 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source7"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM']
df8 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source8"], index_col=0)  # ['ROW_WID', 'VISITS_NUM']
df9 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source9"], index_col=0)  # same schema as df2

# Step 2: Union all source tables with the same schema as the target's main dimension table:
# Sources with schema: ['CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED', 'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP']
# These are df2, df3, df4, df9
df_dim = pd.concat([df2, df3, df4, df9], ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: Join the dimension table with all aspect tables on 'ROW_WID'
# Aspect tables: df0 (COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM), df1 (INTERACTIONS_NUM), df5 (INBOUND_CALLS_NUM), df6 (KEYWORDS_NUM), df7 (TECHSUPPORT_NUM), df8 (VISITS_NUM)

# We will do left joins on df_dim to keep all rows from dimension table and add aspect info where available

# Join with df0
df_merged = pd.merge(df_dim, df0, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with df1
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df1, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with df5
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df5, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with df6
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df6, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with df7
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df7, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with df8
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df8, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Step 4: Fill missing numeric columns with 0 (assuming missing means zero counts)
num_cols_fill_zero = [
    "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM",
    "INTERACTIONS_NUM",
    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM",
    "KEYWORDS_NUM",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM",
    "VISITS_NUM",
]
for col in num_cols_fill_zero:
    if col in df_merged.columns:
        df_merged[col] = df_merged[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Step 5: Ensure data types match target schema
# Target schema:
# ['CANCELED': int, 'ROW_WID': int, 'ACCNT_LOC': int, 'ARPU': float, 'SES': str, 'HOME_PASSED': int,
#  'CUST_SINCE_DT': str, 'MONTHS_AGE': float, 'CANCEL_DT': str, 'CITY': str, 'POP': str,
#  'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM': int, 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM': int, 'KEYWORDS_NUM': int, 'VISITS_NUM': int,
#  'TECHSUPPORT_NUM': int, 'INTERACTIONS_NUM': int]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
df_merged["CANCELED"] = df_merged["CANCELED"].astype(int)
df_merged["ROW_WID"] = df_merged["ROW_WID"].astype(int)
df_merged["ACCNT_LOC"] = df_merged["ACCNT_LOC"].astype(int)
df_merged["ARPU"] = df_merged["ARPU"].astype(float)
df_merged["SES"] = df_merged["SES"].astype(str)
df_merged["HOME_PASSED"] = df_merged["HOME_PASSED"].astype(int)
df_merged["CUST_SINCE_DT"] = df_merged["CUST_SINCE_DT"].astype(str)
df_merged["MONTHS_AGE"] = df_merged["MONTHS_AGE"].astype(float)

# CANCEL_DT, CITY, POP can have missing values, convert to string and fill NaN with empty string
df_merged["CANCEL_DT"] = df_merged["CANCEL_DT"].fillna("").astype(str)
df_merged["CITY"] = df_merged["CITY"].fillna("").astype(str)
df_merged["POP"] = df_merged["POP"].fillna("").astype(str)

# Step 6: Reorder columns to match target schema exactly

    "CANCELED",
    "ROW_WID",
    "ACCNT_LOC",
    "ARPU",
    "SES",
    "HOME_PASSED",
    "CUST_SINCE_DT",
    "MONTHS_AGE",

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Step 7: Export the final dataframe to the target CSV file

# Group by leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema:
